steps.text: The profile shows the seeded defaults: Demo User, demo@example.com and the Brussels address as injected by the database fixtures.
steps.title: Default profile

steps.text: Click "Update profile" to open the dialog containing the editable first name, last name and related fields.
steps.title: Open the form

steps.text: Type the new first name and last name in their respective fields. The save button enables once both fields are populated.
steps.title: Enter the new name

steps.text: Click "Save" to send the updated information to the CRM. The dialog closes once the update is acknowledged.
steps.title: Save the changes

steps.text: Back on the profile page, the new first and last name appear immediately — the change has been persisted server-side.
steps.title: Profile updated
